id: 672-努恩·烏卓爾·查克征服多斯皮拉斯
theater: 佩滕盆地佩特克斯巴通河谷

battle.name: 努恩·烏卓爾·查克征服多斯皮拉斯
battle.theater: 佩滕盆地佩特克斯巴通河谷
battle.brief: 公元672年，蒂卡爾王努恩·烏卓爾·查克結束流亡回師，攻入佩特克斯巴通河谷，收復被蛇王國卡拉克穆爾扶植的附庸多斯皮拉斯，並把王座西遷至此，蒂卡爾本城自此空置。卡上的羅馬方陣盾並非戰場實物；佩滕沒有盾牆，瑪雅戰士靠投槍器、圓盾與纏棉甲在雨林小徑上機動。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰雙方都是佩滕盆地與佩特克斯巴通河谷的瑪雅城邦國家，靠盟誓、進貢與儀式維持秩序，沒有常備軍，也沒有統一戰區。北方一方是蒂卡爾（碑銘作 Mutal）：王努恩·烏卓爾·查克是「神聖之主」k'uhul ajaw，權力寄託在石碑、年終時期終結儀式與附屬小寨的效忠上；軍隊是貴族率領的私人戰團（nahal）與各村落民兵，獅豹與貓頭鷹名號標示親征的勇將，沒有兵種編制，也沒有獨立後勤。南方一方是 629 年由蒂卡爾設立的佩特克斯巴通前哨多斯皮拉斯：該城 635 年由四歲的巴萊·錢·卡威爾登位並沿用蒂卡爾的髮束徽記，648 年被蛇王國卡拉克穆爾攻入後扶作附庸，遂成卡拉克穆爾插入佩滕南部的刀尖；672 年被蒂卡爾收復之後，多斯皮拉斯反過來成為蒂卡爾王朝的新首都。牽連在內的還有佩滕東北部湖區的烏阿克通（Uaxactun），其主尤克諾姆·切恩二世（Yuknoom Ch'een II）受卡拉克穆爾支持；以及中烏蘇馬辛塔的伊察與奇科姆普圖恩集團，多斯皮拉斯失勢時他們是收留者，蒂卡爾收復之後則成了新秩序的支柱。
countriesEn: Both sides were Maya city-state polities of the Petén Basin and the Petexbatún valley, held together by sworn alliance, tribute and ceremony rather than by standing armies or a unified theatre. On the northern side stood Tikal, written in the inscriptions as Mutal: its ruler Nuun Uchol Chaak was a k'uhul ajaw, a Divine Lord, whose authority rested on carved stelae, the year-ending period-closing rites and the loyalty of dependent towns; his field force was the private war band of the nobility together with militia mustered from the villages, with the Jaguar and Owl orders marking warriors who fought in person, and there were neither service branches nor a separate logistics establishment. On the southern side stood Dos Pilas, the Petexbatún outpost that Tikal had founded in 629: the city was crowned in 635 by the four-year-old B'alaj Chan K'awiil, who adopted Tikal's hair-bundle emblem, and after the snake kingdom of Calakmul stormed it in 648 and set him up as a vassal it became the blade Calakmul pushed into southern Petén; once Tikal recovered it in 672, Dos Pilas turned into the new capital of the Tikal dynasty. Others pulled in were Uaxactun in the north-eastern lake district of Petén, whose lord Yuknoom Ch'een II was backed by Calakmul, and the Itza and Chicom Putun groups of the middle Usumacinta, who sheltered the displaced Dos Pilas royal house and, after the recovery of 672, became the props of the new order.
people: 決定 672 年局面的，是蒂卡爾王努恩·烏卓爾·查克（Nuun Uchol Chaak，又作 Nuun Ujol Chaak）本人。他約在 648 年前後繼承蒂卡爾王位；657 年多斯皮拉斯聯軍攻入佩滕南部時，他被迫放棄都城而流亡，五年之後回師，於 672 年、長紀曆 9.12.0.0.0 時期終結前後奪回多斯皮拉斯，把該城立為王朝新都，蒂卡爾本城自此空置。他的對手巴萊·錢·卡威爾（B'alaj Chan K'awiil）625 年生，四歲登位，648 年被卡拉克穆爾俘獲而未遭獻祭，657 年藉蛇王國之力反攻蒂卡爾，672 年再度失勢，帶著王族與隨從退入森林與同盟者之地，此後再沒有回到多斯皮拉斯。其後由他的兩個兒子伊察姆納阿·巴蘭與伊察姆納阿·卡威爾接續主持該城。677 年，烏阿克通王尤克諾姆·切恩二世趁佩滕亂局出兵，戰爭的目標正是坐鎮多斯皮拉斯的努恩·烏卓爾·查克；同一時期，多斯皮拉斯舊王室一方在卡拉克穆爾襄助下復位，兩股力量在佩里一帶於 679 年爆發大會戰，多斯皮拉斯以援軍取勝，多斯皮拉斯石板 D1 至 D3 即記下戰後的「血池」與「頭顱堆」。學界方面，格林威治對照值的建立與碑銘釋讀，使這段佩滕斷裂期得以排出可核對的年表。
peopleEn: The man who decided the issue of 672 was Tikal's king Nuun Uchol Chaak, also written Nuun Ujol Chaak, himself. He took the Tikal throne around 648; when Dos Pilas coalition forces drove into southern Petén in 657 he was forced out of his capital and into exile, and five years later he came back, seized Dos Pilas around the period-closing date of Long Count 9.12.0.0.0, made that city the seat of his dynasty, and Tikal itself stood empty from then on. His opponent B'alaj Chan K'awiil, born in 625, had taken the throne at four years of age, was taken prisoner by Calakmul in 648 and spared the sacrificial stone, and struck back at Tikal in 657 on Calakmul's strength; in 672 he was again on the losing side and withdrew with his household and followers into the forest and the lands of his allies, and he never came back to Dos Pilas. His two sons Itzamnaaj B'alam and Itzamnaaj K'awiil afterwards carried on the rule of that city. In 677 Yuknoom Ch'een II of Uaxactun moved against the confusion in Petén, and the object of that war was precisely the Nuun Uchol Chaak who now sat at Dos Pilas; in the same period the old Dos Pilas royal house was restored with Calakmul's backing, and the two forces met in a great battle around El Perú in 679, which Dos Pilas won with outside support, and the Dos Pilas panels D1 to D3 record the pools of blood and the piles of heads that followed. On the scholarly side, the establishment of the Greenwich correlation and the decipherment of the inscriptions are what allow this Petén interregnum to be set on a checkable chronology.
kits: 本卡以一件羅馬方陣盾（Scutum，約公元前 100 年定型）作為這場戰爭的代表。Scutum 是羅馬軍團步兵的標準防具：長方而微凸，上緣抬高管及頭肩，可擋開自上方來襲的箭，盾面凸起並在中央隆起，用來承受撞擊與刺擊；高約一公尺，重量約六至七公斤。羅馬人靠盾緣互相咬合成連續防線，並在受弓箭壓制時收成龜甲陣，而不是靠盾牌本身多厚。卡上的這件盾從未出現在中美洲，沒有任何考古證據顯示它到達過佩滕盆地；它在此代表的是「以盾集結正面」這個角色位置。瑪雅戰士的對應裝備是另一套系統：投槍器配黑曜石或石片鑲嵌的標槍，蒂卡爾 31 號石碑上的青年武士就一手持投槍器、一手持飾有雨水神面容的圓盾；長矛用於列陣與進攻，矛頭以燧石打製；短兵器有鋤形棍棒，以及鑲黑曜石刃的木質長劍（macuahuitl）與石刃棍（tecpatl），但後兩者定型於後古典時期，七世紀中葉的佩滕尚未普遍裝備。防護只有棉或藤織的胸背纏帶、木甲片與矩形盾（texcaxtli），沒有金屬甲。瑪雅軍隊沒有馬匹、沒有車、沒有輪式運輸，也沒有攻城塔與投石機；攻堅靠圍困、火攻、斷水、封鎖堤道與奪取城門，糧秣靠人力背運玉米餅與鹽，部隊則沿帕西翁河與烏蘇馬辛塔河用獨木舟機動。
kitsEn: This card stands for the war with a Roman scutum, the legionary shield that took its classic form around 100 BC. The scutum was the standard protection of the Roman infantry: a tall rectangle curved in plan, wide enough to cover the body, its upper edge raised to shield the head and shoulder and turn aside shots from above, its convex face and central boss there to take the shock of thrusts and blows; it stood about a metre tall and weighed some six to seven kilograms. The Romans built their line by locking shield edge to shield edge and closed into a testudo under missile fire rather than relying on the thickness of the shield itself. The shield on this card never appeared in Mesoamerica, and no archaeological evidence shows that it ever reached the Petén Basin; on the card it stands for the role of massing a front with shields. The Maya warrior's corresponding kit was a different system altogether: the atlatl or spear-thrower with obsidian- or flake-set darts, and on Stela 31 at Tikal a young warrior is shown holding a spear-thrower in one hand and a round shield decorated with the face of the rain god in the other. Long spears were formed up for the attack, their heads ground from chert; short arms included the hoe-shaped club, the macuahuitl or wooden sword with obsidian blades, and the tecpatl, a stone-edged club, although the latter two were consolidated in the Postclassic and were not yet generally worn in mid-seventh-century Petén. Protection amounted to cotton or fibre-woven body bands, wooden slats and the rectangular texcaxtli shield; there was no metal armour. The Maya army had no horses, no carts, no wheeled transport, no siege towers and no stone-throwers. Reduction of a city was done by blockade, fire, cutting the water, sealing the causeways and seizing the gates; supplies were carried by porters as maize cakes and salt; and the columns moved by canoe along the Pasión and Usumacinta rivers.
tactics: 這場戰爭屬於瑪雅人所謂 hoyo，即「星戰」：目標不是殲滅敵軍，而是奪取對方的君主與都城，勝負以是否握住王位衡量。672 年的作戰有兩層。軍事上，蒂卡爾的反攻沿佩特克斯巴通河谷推進，先清除多斯皮拉斯在南佩滕的外圍小寨與鹽場，切斷村社與外界的往來，再直趨城垣；瑪雅城四周有堤道、壕溝與人工水庫，進攻者常圍而不攻，等城中飢餓、內鬥或貴族倒戈，才由內應開門，或強攻城門擒住國王與王族。政治上，奪城之後必須完成一次「建城儀式」：多斯皮拉斯的名字意為「三堆石」，碑銘記錄的正是重新立柱、設石與舉行時期終結禮的動作，藉此宣告新王朝的正統；同時把蒂卡爾本城留作空城，製造「王都西遷」的既成事實。行軍多在乾季（11 月至翌年 5 月）進行，6 月至 10 月雨季令道路泥濘、糧秣難運；隊伍夜間或拂曉出發，利用雨林與沼澤遮蔽接近。編制上仍是若干貴族率領的戰團，獅豹與貓頭鷹兩種精兵名號標示親征者；沒有軍旗，也沒有可供排演的固定陣線，勝負常取決於先手與近身纏鬥的節奏。679 年佩里一帶的大會戰是同一套邏輯的放大版：聯軍以多路同時壓上，防守方以投槍器覆蓋接近段，待對方進入城郊與堤道地帶才發動反擊，最後以近身戰與俘虜獻祭收尾。
tacticsEn: This war belongs to what the Maya called a hoyo, a star war: its aim was not to annihilate the enemy army but to take the opposing ruler and his capital, and the result was measured by whether a throne changed hands. The campaign of 672 had two layers. Militarily, the Tikal counter-attack advanced up the Petexbatún valley, first clearing the outer towns and salt works of Dos Pilas in southern Petén and cutting those villages off from the outside world, then driving straight at the walls; since a Maya city was ringed by causeways, ditches and artificial reservoirs, the attackers as often invested as they assaulted, waiting for hunger, factional fighting or a defection among the nobles until an insider opened a gate or the gate itself was forced and the king with his household was taken. Politically, taking the city was not enough, because a founding rite had to be performed. The name Dos Pilas means three piles of stone, and what the inscriptions record is precisely the re-setting of the column, the placing of the stones and the holding of the period-ending ceremony, by which the new dynasty announced its legitimacy; and Tikal was left standing empty so that the fact of the westward move of the royal seat became a fait accompli. Campaigns were fought in the dry season, from November through May, since the rains from June to October turned the roads to mud and made supply lines fail; columns moved by night or at first light, using rainforest and marsh to mask the approach. The force remained a number of war bands led by nobles, with the Jaguar and Owl orders marking those who fought in person; there were no standards and no rehearsed battle line, and the outcome often turned on the initiative and the rhythm of the close struggle. The great battle around El Perú in 679 was the same logic on a larger scale: the coalition pressed on several fronts at once, the defenders covered the approach with the atlatl, struck back when the enemy came into the open ground and the causeways outside the city, and finished with close combat and the sacrifice of prisoners.
data: 可核對的數字集中在地理與年表上。蒂卡爾在佩滕盆地中部，多斯皮拉斯在其西南約 110 公里，烏阿克通在佩滕東北部，兩地之間隔著沼澤與石灰岩脊；多斯皮拉斯城址位於帕西翁河與薩利納斯河之間，海拔約 160 公尺，地區年雨量約 2,500 毫米，蒂卡爾約 1,945 毫米；多斯皮拉斯王國鼎盛時控制約 1,500 平方英里，即 3,885 平方公里；卡拉克穆爾王國約 13,000 平方公里，城址已識別出 6,750 座建築，主金字塔高逾 45 公尺，連同鄉村的人口估計約 175 萬；蒂卡爾核心區逾 16 平方公里，約 3,000 座建築，城內另有 10 座蓄水庫。年表方面：629 年多斯皮拉斯建立，635 年巴萊·錢·卡威爾登位，648 年轉投卡拉克穆爾，657 年多斯皮拉斯聯軍攻入蒂卡爾，672 年努恩·烏卓爾·查克收復多斯皮拉斯，677 年烏阿克通方面開戰，679 年佩里一帶大會戰，695 年蒂卡爾一度取勝，705 年其君主被俘，731 年前後多斯皮拉斯陷落，738 年卡拉克穆爾退出，761 年末代君主出走；長紀曆 9.12.0.0.0 對應西曆 672 年，9.15.0.0.0 對應 731 年，而 672 年這一次「征服」在碑銘上留下的直接證據只有多斯皮拉斯 2 號石碑的時期終結記錄與其後的石板組，遠少於它在後世年表裡的分量。
dataEn: The checkable figures are mostly geographic and chronological. Tikal lies in the middle of the Petén Basin, Dos Pilas lies some 110 kilometres to its south-west, and Uaxactun lies in the north-east of the basin, with swamp and limestone ridge between them; the site of Dos Pilas stands between the Pasión and the Salinas rivers at about 160 metres above sea level, the region receives roughly 2,500 millimetres of rain a year against about 1,945 millimetres at Tikal; the Dos Pilas kingdom at its height controlled some 1,500 square miles, that is 3,885 square kilometres; the Calakmul kingdom covered about 13,000 square kilometres, 6,750 structures have been identified at its city and its main pyramid rises more than 45 metres, with roughly 1.75 million people including the countryside; the Tikal core covers more than 16 square kilometres with about 3,000 structures, and the city also holds ten reservoirs. The chronology runs: Dos Pilas founded in 629, the coronation of B'alaj Chan K'awiil in 635, the switch to Calakmul in 648, the Dos Pilas coalition attack on Tikal in 657, the recovery of Dos Pilas by Nuun Uchol Chaak in 672, the opening of war by Uaxactun in 677, the great battle around El Perú in 679, a Tikal success in 695, the capture of Tikal's lord in 705, the fall of Dos Pilas around 731, the withdrawal of Calakmul in 738, and the flight of the last ruler in 761; Long Count 9.12.0.0.0 corresponds to AD 672 and 9.15.0.0.0 to AD 731, while the direct epigraphic evidence for the conquest of 672 amounts to the period-closing record of Dos Pilas Stela 2 and the panel group that followed it, far less than the weight the event carries in later chronologies.
cause: 672 年的收復不是突然而起的復讐，而是三層原因疊加。第一層是王權合法性：多斯皮拉斯沿用蒂卡爾的髮束徽記，卻在 648 年之後接受卡拉克穆爾的蛇王頭銜，自居為佩滕南部的主人；對蒂卡爾王室而言，多斯皮拉斯是一個「盜用了我們徽記的城市」，不收回來，王室的正統敘事就永遠裂著一條縫。第二層是商路與資源：佩特克斯巴通沿線承載佩滕南部的鹽、黑曜石、染料與玉米運輸，鹽來自薩利納斯河，黑曜石來自南部高地；控制多斯皮拉斯與佩特克斯巴通，就等於掐住佩滕南部的進出口，而這條線的稅賦與進貢，正是當年建城時寫進城邦契約的理由。第三層是 657 年之後的實力消長：多斯皮拉斯的聯軍雖逼走了蒂卡爾王，卻沒有能力長期佔領盆地核心；卡拉克穆爾要把勢力伸進佩滕南部又需要一個常駐前哨，戰爭的消耗令雙方都亟需一次攤牌。於是 672 年，蒂卡爾王帶著流亡五年累積的盟友與兵力回師，把一次「星戰」做成一次王朝遷都：奪城、舉行建城儀式、西遷王座，讓一個分裂出去的城邦重新回到母城的旗色之下。
causeEn: The recovery of 672 was not a sudden act of vengeance; three layers of cause stack on top of each other. The first is royal legitimacy. Dos Pilas carried Tikal's hair-bundle emblem, yet after 648 it accepted the overlordship of the Snake King of Calakmul and set itself up as the master of southern Petén; for the Tikal royal house Dos Pilas was a city that had stolen its emblem, and until it was recovered the dynastic story of legitimacy stayed cracked open. The second is trade and resources: the Petexbatún corridor carried the salt, obsidian, dye and maize of southern Petén, salt coming from the Salinas and obsidian from the highlands to the south; whoever held Dos Pilas and the Petexbatún held the gateway to the southern basin, and the tolls and tribute on that line were part of the terms on which the city had been founded in the first place. The third is the shift in strength after 657. The Dos Pilas coalition had driven Tikal's king out, but it could not hold the heart of the basin for long, and Calakmul needed a permanent forward post in southern Petén; the cost of the war left both sides needing a single decisive reckoning. So in 672 the Tikal king came back with the allies and troops gathered in five years of exile and turned a star war into a dynastic migration: take the city, perform the founding rite, move the throne west, and bring a city that had split away back under the colours of the mother city.
impact: 這一役的直接後果，是佩滕考古學上「蒂卡爾中斷期」的重新劃定。過去學者多把蒂卡爾的蕭條起點放在 657 年那次失敗上，672 年的收復把時間線推到另一個起點：蒂卡爾本城自 672 年起空置，王座與祭祀中心西移到多斯皮拉斯，直到 731 年前後多斯皮拉斯陷落、蒂卡爾復都，中斷期前後延續約六十年，長紀曆 9.12.0.0.0 至 9.15.0.0.0 兩個時期終結日正好框住這段空白。制度上，多斯皮拉斯在 672 年之後不再只是前哨，而是蒂卡爾王朝的正統首都，碑銘、年終儀式與王族譜系都改在佩特克斯巴通書寫，南方小寨與伊察、奇科姆普圖恩等同盟者的服從關係也重新洗牌。戰略上，672 年之後兩年內便爆發 677 與 679 兩戰，說明「奪王」這種總攻一旦發動就難以收手：卡拉克穆爾不肯坐看佩滕重新統一，於是推動烏阿克通出兵，679 年佩里一帶的大會戰以多斯皮拉斯獲勝告終，記錄此役的正是多斯皮拉斯石板 D1 至 D3，那是經典期最詳細的戰場敘事之一，寫下「血池」與「頭顱堆」。對後世研究而言，672 年還提示一件事：瑪雅城邦的「建城」不是永久的地理事實，而是一個可以被推翻、也可以被重新宣示的政治宣告。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of that campaign was a re-dating of what archaeologists call the Tikal hiatus. The old start of Tikal's lean years was placed at the defeat of 657, but the recovery of 672 moved the line to a different starting point: Tikal itself stood empty from 672 while the throne and the ritual centre shifted west to Dos Pilas, and they did not go back until the fall of Dos Pilas around 731 and the reoccupation of Tikal, so that the interruption ran for some sixty years, framed exactly by two period-closing dates, Long Count 9.12.0.0.0 and 9.15.0.0.0. Institutionally, after 672 Dos Pilas was no longer a forward post but the legitimate capital of the Tikal dynasty; stelae, year-ending rites and royal genealogies were henceforth written in the Petexbatún, and the loyalty of the southern towns and of allies such as the Itza and the Chicom Putun was reshuffled along with it. Tactically, two wars broke out within two years of 672, which shows how hard a general campaign of this kind was to call off once launched: Calakmul would not sit still while Petén reunified, and so pushed the Uaxactun expedition; the great battle around El Perú in 679 ended in a Dos Pilas victory, and the record of it is the Dos Pilas Panels D1 to D3, among the most detailed battle narratives of the Classic period, with their pools of blood and piles of heads. For later scholarship, 672 also teaches one thing: a Maya foundation is not a permanent geographical fact but a political claim that can be overturned and can also be re-asserted.
result: 結果是清楚的：672 年，努恩·烏卓爾·查克率領的蒂卡爾方面攻入多斯皮拉斯，奪回城市與佩特克斯巴通的控制權，巴萊·錢·卡威爾的舊勢力帶著王族退入森林與邊境；多斯皮拉斯隨即以新王朝都城的姿態重新建城，碑銘記下設石、立壇與時期終結的儀式，蒂卡爾本城則被有意留空，王權的實際中心整整西移約 110 公里，直到 731 年前後才回到原地。多斯皮拉斯並未被摧毀，反而在 672 年之後達到頂點：679 年佩里一帶擊敗以烏阿克通為首的聯軍，705 年更生擒蒂卡爾之主，一度扶植外來君主坐鎮王座。代價則在南方，卡拉克穆爾的勢力藉此收復佩滕南部，直到 738 年前後蒂卡爾逐出卡拉克穆爾的影響、南佩滕的舊秩序鬆動，761 年多斯皮拉斯末代君主棄城出走，這個王國才真正從地圖上消失。整體看，672 年的收復以王朝西遷的方式解決了分裂，卻把佩滕的權力重心推到西部，為八世紀末的經典期崩潰埋下伏線。
resultEn: The outcome is plain. In 672 the Tikal forces under Nuun Uchol Chaak drove into Dos Pilas, took back the city and control of the Petexbatún, and drove the old B'alaj Chan K'awiil faction with its royal household into the forest and the frontier; Dos Pilas was then re-founded in the posture of the new dynasty's capital, with the inscriptions recording the placing of the stones, the raising of the altar and the period-closing ceremony, while Tikal itself was deliberately left empty and the effective centre of power moved a hundred and ten kilometres west until the city was retaken around 731. Dos Pilas was not destroyed; on the contrary it reached its height after 672, defeating a coalition led by Uaxactun around El Perú in 679 and, in 705, taking Tikal's lord alive and for a time seating an outsider on his throne. The price was paid in the south: Calakmul recovered its position in southern Petén, and only when Tikal drove Calakmul's influence out around 738 and the old southern order loosened could the region settle; in 761 the last ruler of Dos Pilas walked out of his city and the kingdom really did vanish from the map. On the whole, the recovery of 672 settled the split by moving the dynasty west, but it pushed the centre of gravity of Petén westward and laid the ground for the Classic collapse at the end of the eighth century.
